- **`light-dark(a, b)`** → two chips labeled **Light** and **Dark**, both branches painted at once so you don't have to toggle themes.
- **Whole-cell only** — a `light-dark(rgba…)` buried inside a box-shadow value gets no swatch (verified: `--instui-elevation-above` shows nothing).
- Each chip sits over a neutral checkerboard so translucent colors read as translucent.

**Files:**
- `docs/.vitepress/plugins/token-value-preview.ts` — replaces `token-image-preview.ts`; one `code_inline` override does images first, then colors (top-level comma split so `rgba(…)` args survive; tight color validation before anything hits a `style` attribute).
- [config.ts](docs/.vitepress/config.ts) — import/use updated to `tokenValuePreview`.
- [pantoken.css](docs/.vitepress/theme/pantoken.css) — `.pantoken-swatch` styles (formatter reflowed the multi-value backgrounds).
